infrastructure_alerts.title: Magnetic Island — Sooning Street Bridge
infrastructure_alerts.details: Bridge remains closed to vehicles as construction continues. Pedestrian access is available. Expect mid-to-late 2026 reopening.
infrastructure_alerts.detour: Use Kelly St and Mandalay Ave to access the island's north side.

infrastructure_alerts.title: Jezzine Boardwalk — Refurbishment
infrastructure_alerts.details: Boardwalk is fully accessible. Stay alert for maintenance crews between 8am and 3pm.

infrastructure_alerts.title: Game Day Traffic — Lowths Bridge
infrastructure_alerts.details: Expect heavy pedestrian traffic around Lowths Bridge and the Stadium from early afternoon for the Cowboys vs Wests Tigers home game (NRLW Knights also playing that day). No game-day traffic impact this week — the Cowboys are away at the Gold Coast Titans on Thursday August 6.

beaches.name: The Strand
beaches.notes: Townsville's iconic 2.5 km foreshore with swimming enclosures, cafes, and walking paths. Stinger nets removed for the dry season — open-water swimming risk significantly reduced.

beaches.name: Pallarenda Beach
beaches.notes: Quiet stretch of sand with views of Magnetic Island; popular for dog walking and picnics. Great for low-tide afternoon walks.

beaches.name: Saunders Beach
beaches.notes: A local favourite for a peaceful escape. Easy parking, fewer crowds, and a steady sea breeze. About 30 minutes north of the city. Off-leash dog-friendly areas available.

beaches.name: Toolakea Beach
beaches.notes: Best for low-tide walks and photography. Vast sand flats at low tide. One of the quieter northern beaches — a true local hidden gem.

beaches.name: Bushland Beach
beaches.notes: Wide sandy beach perfect for sunset walks and fishing; small shopping centre nearby. Off-leash dog area.

beaches.name: Balgal Beach
beaches.notes: Family-friendly beach north of Townsville with safe swimming, playgrounds, and caravan park.

beaches.name: Toomulla Beach
beaches.notes: Quiet beach with a boat ramp and camping area, ideal for fishing and nature walks.

restaurants.name: JAM Corner
restaurants.notes: Award-winning dining with seasonal local produce and fine wines.

restaurants.name: Shorehouse
restaurants.notes: Contemporary oceanfront restaurant known for seafood and cocktails with sunset views.

restaurants.name: Cactus Jack's
restaurants.notes: Casual, lively Mexican dining with margaritas and family-friendly vibes.

restaurants.name: Bridgewater Restaurant
restaurants.notes: Upscale dining with an open kitchen and local ingredients, plus a cocktail bar.

restaurants.name: The Courtyard
restaurants.notes: Trendy outdoor bar serving gourmet burgers and live music on weekends.

restaurants.name: Juliette's Gelateria
restaurants.notes: Popular café for coffee, desserts, and beach views; pet friendly.

dog_parks.name: Rowes Bay Dog Park
dog_parks.notes: Large, shaded area near the beach with water bowls and bins.

dog_parks.name: Murray Sporting Complex
dog_parks.notes: Spacious dog area with agility equipment and shade.

dog_parks.name: Aitkenvale Park
dog_parks.notes: Central fenced park with grass, trees, and seating.

dog_parks.name: Riverway Parklands
dog_parks.notes: Beautiful riverside paths for walking dogs; water stations available.

dog_parks.name: The Strand Foreshore
dog_parks.notes: Dogs allowed on-leash; enjoy the foreshore path and ocean breeze.

dog_parks.name: Bushland Beach Reserve
dog_parks.notes: Popular with locals for long runs and swimming with dogs.

accommodation.name: The Ville Resort–Casino
accommodation.notes: Upscale beachfront resort with pools, casino, spa, and dining.

accommodation.name: Aquarius on the Beach
accommodation.notes: Affordable hotel with unbeatable ocean views and balconies.

accommodation.name: Hotel Grand Chancellor Townsville
accommodation.notes: Modern high-rise hotel with rooftop views and close to nightlife.

accommodation.name: Quest Townsville
accommodation.notes: Self-contained apartments perfect for families and longer stays.

accommodation.name: Rambutan Resort
accommodation.notes: Trendy rooftop resort-style stay with bar, pool, and private rooms.

accommodation.name: BIG4 Rowes Bay Holiday Park
accommodation.notes: Beachfront park with cabins, powered sites, and family-friendly facilities.

things_to_do.name: Castle Hill
things_to_do.notes: Climb or drive to the top for panoramic city and island views.

things_to_do.name: Magnetic Island
things_to_do.notes: Wildlife, beaches, and scenic hikes just a 20-minute ferry away.

things_to_do.name: Jezzine Barracks
things_to_do.notes: Coastal boardwalk with art, military history, and ocean views.

things_to_do.name: Billabong Sanctuary
things_to_do.notes: Meet koalas and feed kangaroos at this award-winning sanctuary. Open daily 9:00 AM – 4:00 PM with standard show schedule running.

things_to_do.name: Riverway Lagoons
things_to_do.notes: Lagoon pools, picnic areas, and walking paths along Ross River.

things_to_do.name: The Strand Waterpark
things_to_do.notes: Free kids' splash park with shaded play area and ocean backdrop.

shopping.name: Stockland Townsville
shopping.notes: Largest mall in North Queensland with fashion, food, and entertainment.

shopping.name: Willows Shopping Centre
shopping.notes: Indoor centre with major retailers, cafes, and weekend markets.

shopping.name: Fairfield Central
shopping.notes: Modern shopping hub with Woolworths, Kmart, and eateries.

shopping.name: Cotters Market
shopping.notes: Local arts, crafts, and food stalls every Sunday morning.

shopping.name: Flinders Street Boutiques
shopping.notes: Independent stores and designer shops in the city centre.

shopping.name: Domain Central
shopping.notes: Large retail park with furniture, electronics, and homewares.

emergency.vet: Townsville Veterinary Clinic, 34 Bowen Road, Hermit Park

transport.bus: Sunbus Townsville – main routes connect the Strand, City, and Stockland
transport.ferry: Magnetic Island Ferry – departs from Breakwater Terminal every 20–30 mins

hairdressers.name: Just Cuts Castletown
hairdressers.notes: Walk-in only, open 9am–5:30pm Mon–Sat, 10am–4pm Sun. Affordable cuts for all ages.

hairdressers.name: Pure Hair
hairdressers.notes: Modern salon offering cuts and colour, online booking available.

hairdressers.name: Silver Strand Hair Studio
hairdressers.notes: Popular beachfront salon with friendly staff and sea views.

hairdressers.name: The Barber Shop Townsville
hairdressers.notes: Traditional barber offering hot towel shaves, beard trims, and modern cuts.

suburbs.name: North Ward
suburbs.vibe: Coastal, walkable CBD-adjacent suburb — heritage Queenslanders and apartments right on The Strand.

suburbs.name: Kirwan
suburbs.vibe: Large established western family suburb — big blocks, strong school catchments, close to Willows.

suburbs.name: Idalia
suburbs.vibe: Newer masterplanned suburb across the Ross River — modern homes close to the Hospital and stadium.

suburbs.name: Douglas
suburbs.vibe: University and Hospital precinct — built around JCU and Townsville University Hospital.

suburbs.name: Aitkenvale
suburbs.vibe: Central retail and services hub — home to Stockland Townsville and most of the city's medical/dining strip.

suburbs.name: Annandale
suburbs.vibe: Leafy south-side family suburb — quieter streets, local shops, handy to the Hospital and JCU.

suburbs.name: Garbutt
suburbs.vibe: Airport-adjacent redevelopment story — newer developments like The Haven bringing modern homes close to the CBD.

suburbs.name: Bushland Beach
suburbs.vibe: Coastal community on the northern fringe — genuine local-swim beach, roughly 20–25 minutes from the CBD.

suburbs.name: Rowes Bay
suburbs.vibe: Beachfront living minutes from the CBD, The Strand and Jezzine Barracks — popular with Defence families.

suburbs.name: North Shore
suburbs.vibe: Northern growth heart — modern homes, 42km of walking trails, and the best community leisure centre in the city.

suburbs.name: Pallarenda
suburbs.vibe: Quiet peninsula suburb wrapped around a national park with an off-leash dog beach.

suburbs.name: Saunders Beach
suburbs.vibe: Quiet northern escape — 6km of unspoilt sand, about 30 minutes from the CBD, locals-only feel.
